title: Snowmobile in the Desert
coreMove: Diagnose the terrain before you label the person as defective.
sourcePressure: Uses the snowmobile metaphor to diagnose fit before blame: poor performance may reveal a mismatch between human design, conditions, incentives, and environment.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Excusing all underperformance as environmental or turning fit into a personality-matching exercise.

counterintuition: numbers versus people as a flat binary

exampleSpecs.audience: education lead judging a quiet guide
exampleSpecs.stakes: poor engagement may be bad station fit, not laziness
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she moves the guide from crowd patter to specimen prep and watches questions improve
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a wet starfish tray under blue lights

exampleSpecs.stakes: new scanner layout may create failure terrain
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he walks the route with a carrier and notices the label-window height forces wrist turns
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a mail tub under a tilted label window

exampleSpecs.stakes: alarm volume and script order may overload judgment
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the trainer swaps the script prompts and asks the dispatcher to handle one call with the new order
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a headset coiled beside a laminated script

exampleSpecs.stakes: late entrances come from a sightline mismatch
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the conductor sits behind the timpani and sees the baton disappear behind the basses
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a timpani mallet on a marked part

exampleSpecs.stakes: seedling loss follows a humidity setup no one explained
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the manager moves the mist timer control to eye level and shows the tray survival difference
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a plug tray under a mist nozzle

exampleSpecs.stakes: routing software may pit helpers against impossible gates
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the dispatcher rides the route once and redraws assignments by elevator distance
exampleSpecs.firstImage: an elevator map tucked behind a radio

skillTargets: separate person defect from condition mismatch

tryThisNowSpec: Before your next performance judgment, list two terrain factors that would make a capable person fail here.
